method: Built-in image_gen, one call per map, style-transfer using original runtime overview plus semantic collision guide. Generated files copied verbatim; no pixel editing or resampling.
intendedUse: Terrain replacement only; existing standalone props, enemies, services, portal logic and collision remain runtime-owned.

verification.nativeCollisionOverlay: Pending parent integration. Visual contour similarity is not proof of exact collision/art agreement.
limitations: Tool output resolution is lower than requested; parent owns upscale.
The first forest output retains a few small tree-like silhouettes around internal forest masses. Check against the ground-only guide and existing independent sprites before acceptance.
Generated shores and wooden bank-strip extents require native overlay review; collision/layout was not changed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production asset: terrain-only map painting for an existing orthographic 2D pixel RPG. Create ONE landscape PNG, precisely 2048 by 1408 pixels (64:44 world aspect), full-bleed with no margins.

Image 1 is the old rendered map and supplies exact top-down path/water placement. Image 2 is its authoritative collision guide at the SAME full-map framing: TAN means flat walkable ground; DARK NAVY means impassable forest; dusty purple specks are existing separate prop footprints, which must become flat ground in this painting; dark blue water patch is the same small pool visible bottom-center-left in image1. Preserve geometry and all clearings, internal dark forest islands, branching dirt trails, and north/left/south exits at exactly the same fractional coordinates. Do not crop, rotate, mirror, shift, widen or narrow any path or shore.

Replace the old terrain with a beautifully art-directed storybook fantasy woodland, high orthographic oblique viewpoint, parallel axes, no horizon. Readable emerald and olive grass, warm mossy earth trails with gentle wear, restrained coherent leaf litter and flat embedded stone. Rich depth ONLY in the DARK impassable regions: layered distant woodland canopy, softly shaded forest terraces, huge old root ridges at the boundary; detailed pixel clusters and crisp clean texture, not random grain. Foreground playable floor remains luminous and calm, shadows tied to the same lighting direction from upper left. Every flat TAN area stays flat, clear, walkable and free of obstacles.

CRITICAL TERRAIN-ONLY REMOVAL: remove ALL existing freestanding tree sprites (including every large tree visible inside the clearings), stone archways/gates, tall ruins/columns, signs, rocks, dead trunks, logs, bushes, mushroom objects, arrows, markers, characters, enemies, text, UI and all cast shadows of these individual props. Their original positions must be filled with matching flat ground. Runtime will put those objects back itself. Do NOT copy the existing stone gateways at top corners or east-middle. You may suggest remote tree canopy only within dark blocked regions, never introduce a new standing tree/ruin on TAN space. Keep the small original blue-green pool at its exact outline; no added ponds, no bridges, no river. No white rim around the map, no grid, no labels, no vignette border. Make the painting a continuous spatial scene without changing the game's navigation layout.
